leadIn: By the end of this lesson, learners will be able to:
objectives: Apply React hooks to manage component lifecycle and state in TypeScript components.
Implement useEffect cleanup functions to prevent memory leaks from subscriptions and timers.
Use the useRef hook to store mutable values that persist across renders without triggering re-renders.
Execute conditional logic to check if components are still mounted before updating state.
Define cleanup functions that unsubscribe from event listeners and cancel pending operations.
Construct TypeScript interfaces to type-check props and state for memory leak prevention.
Utilize the dependency array in useEffect to control when effects run and clean up.
Handle asynchronous operations within useEffect with proper cleanup to avoid state updates on unmounted components.
Apply the useCallback hook to memoize functions and prevent unnecessary re-creations in dependency arrays.
Implement the useMemo hook to cache expensive calculations and avoid recomputation on every render.
Control component unmounting behavior by returning cleanup functions from useEffect hooks.
Modify existing components to add proper cleanup mechanisms for timers, subscriptions, and event listeners.
